invariant: Every case is classified CERTIFIED, SUPPORTED_DEGRADED, EXPERIMENTAL or UNSUPPORTED before expensive source processing, from intake facts alone.

CERTIFIED.release_promise: no internal compiler-owned condition may produce ACTION_REQUIRED, SOURCE_REQUIRED or UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE

SUPPORTED_DEGRADED.disclosure: the degraded dimension and the disclosed lower authority or omitted optional evidence MUST appear in the workbook quality disclosure
SUPPORTED_DEGRADED.release_promise: same as CERTIFIED; delivery is lawful only with the degradation disclosed

EXPERIMENTAL.disclosure: run accepted only in a controlled testing ring; output carries an EXPERIMENTAL banner and is not a global release claim
EXPERIMENTAL.release_promise: none - experimental dimensions make no certification claim

UNSUPPORTED.disclosure: the failing dimension and its reason code are reported to the user at preflight
UNSUPPORTED.release_promise: the run stops before document extraction, model compilation or any broker retrieval

early_stop_predicates.rule: entity_type in {bank, insurer, fund, financial_spv, investment_company}
negative_examples: a manufacturer with a captive financing arm consolidated into a predominantly industrial group (mixed_group_predominantly_non_financial)
a holding company over industrial subsidiaries

early_stop_predicates.rule: intake identity resolution reports a MISMATCH verdict between declared entity and sealed filing identity that no identifier tier reconciles
positive_examples: filings for a different legal entity than the declared issuer
a subsidiary filing supplied for a group-level model with no consolidation path
negative_examples: a market-suffixed ticker for the same issuer
a renamed issuer with continuous identifiers

early_stop_predicates.rule: filing_language_format = non_english and no versioned language adapter is declared
negative_examples: an English filing with foreign-language appendices
structured Inline XBRL regardless of label language

positive_examples: a newly listed company with one reported period and no prior filing
negative_examples: two comparatives with a prior filing available for period support (supported_degraded)

positive_examples: a filing supplying only income statement and balance sheet
negative_examples: a condensed interim set that still carries a cash-flow statement (experimental)

EXPERIMENTAL_to_CERTIFIED: at least three independent real filings of the dimension value pass the full raw black-box lane with DELIVERED_VERIFIED or lawfully disclosed DELIVERED_DEGRADED
a registered regression fixture per filing with frozen raw-input hashes
independent oracle and portable validation at zero violations for each
a signed phase-checkpoint entry recording the promotion and its evidence hashes
SUPPORTED_DEGRADED_to_CERTIFIED: the degraded dimension gains a first-class authority (not a fallback) proven on at least two real filings
the disclosure requirement is retired by contract version bump, never silently

workbook_disclosure_specification.wiring_status: run receipts stamped from v3.7.7 (P0.4); the workbook quality-panel stamp lands with the Phase 5 workbook-projection package to avoid unaudited golden churn - tracked, not silent
